title: Oblate orange
html_source:
Oblate spheroid is the shape of a planet, so on one level Stephen means “upon this Earth”. However, ‘oblate’ also has a religious meaning:
“In Christianity, an oblate is a person who is specifically dedicated to God or to God’s service. Oblates are individuals, either laypersons or clergy, normally living in general society, who, while not professed monks or nuns, have individually affiliated themselves with a monastic community of their choice” (from Wikipedia).

Orange also has a special significance in Irish history, since it’s the colour of Unionism. Since Stephen’s altercation was with a pair of British soldiers, this is likely no accident.
